freeze_rules: Each authoritative EXP-0.3.1 requirement has exactly one frozen current status.
implemented_source and source_qualified describe source evidence only and must never be interpreted as deployed, live-qualified, or Genesis-qualified.
partial_source cannot be promoted until its recorded implementation/qualification gaps are resolved.
deployment_pending cannot be promoted from placeholder readiness records, source files, frozen addresses, or CI alone.
runtime_unverified cannot be promoted without target-network runtime/provenance evidence.
optional_unimplemented and post_genesis items are non-blocking unless authoritative scope explicitly changes.
scope_decision_required remains blocking for EXP-0 scope closeout until authoritative sources are reconciled.
No entry is Genesis-qualified at EXP-0.3.4; AC-1 through AC-10 remain unverified.
